characters.summary: Lucius Fox is a brilliant corporate executive, engineer, and inventor rather than a frontline combatant. He relies heavily on advanced Wayne Enterprises technology, gadgets, and tactical planning when forced into high-risk situations.

techniques: Deployment of Wayne Enterprises advanced technology

weaknesses: Standard human physical attributes without superhuman durability or strength
limitations: Lacks combat training or superhuman powers
Dependent on external technological resources for defense and offense

sources.supports: Corporate background, role at Wayne Enterprises, and creation of advanced tech.

campaignTags.claim: Designs and manages advanced technological devices for Batman and Wayne Enterprises
Master engineer and inventor responsible for numerous high-tech gear pieces
Provides advanced tactical gadgets and equipment

unknowns: Exact extent of direct combat training in various continuities

characters.summary: Martian Manhunter is a powerhouse alien hero possessing a vast suite of superhuman abilities, including superhuman strength, flight, telepathy, shape-shifting, and intangibility. He fights using a combination of brute force, mental manipulation, and phase-shifting defense.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to fire (psychological and physiological pyrophobia/weakness in many iterations)
limitations: Psychological or physiological vulnerability to fire can severely incapacitate him

sources.supports: Abilities include shape-shifting, flight, telepathy, intangibility, and Martian vision.

notableResults.citation: Various comic issues showing stalemates due to comparable power levels
notableResults.note: Both hold back during friendly sparring matches.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to fly at hypersonic speeds
Extremely powerful telepath capable of reading and controlling minds globally
Can exert mental control and illusions over opponents
Can regenerate from severe physical damage through shape-shifting mass control
Can render himself completely invisible by bending light or shifting density
Generates and projects Martian vision heat rays

unknowns: Exact threshold of fire vulnerability across different reboots and continuities

characters.continuity: DC Comics JLA: Trial by Fire
characters.summary: Fernus is the ruthless, primal Martian ancestral personality awakened within J'onn J'onnz, completely free of fire-based weaknesses and wielding catastrophic pyrokinetic and psionic power. He dominates opponents through overwhelming offensive force and absolute psychological terror.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to telepathic assault by specialized entities or cooperative psychic effort
characters.formDifferences: Removes the traditional Martian weakness to fire, drastically increases aggressive psionic power, and grants massive pyrokinesis.

sources.supports: Fernus persona representing the burning ancestral Martian race.

unknowns: Full upper limits of destructive output before being subdued

characters.summary: Mister Miracle is the universe's greatest escape artist and a New God of New Genesis. He utilizes advanced Mother Box technology, high-tech aero-pads for flight, and exceptional acrobatic prowess to bypass traps and defeat adversaries.

techniques: Energy blasts via Mother Box or gloves

mechanisms: New God physiology (enhanced durability and strength)

limitations: Gadgets and Mother Box can be disrupted by anti-technology fields

sources.supports: New God physiology, escape artist skills, Mother Box usage, and aero-pads.

campaignTags.claim: Uses aero-pads strapped to his boots for flight
Relies heavily on Mother Box technology and advanced New Genesis gear
Mother Box provides healing and life-support functions
Uses Mother Box to open Boom Tubes for teleportation

unknowns: Exact physical strength ceiling compared to heavy-hitter New Gods like Orion

characters.summary: Mister Mxyzptlk is a mischievous fifth-dimensional imp possessing near-omnipotent reality-warping powers. He engages opponents through bizarre magical and dimensional manipulation, treating combat like a game unless tricked into saying his name backward.
weaknesses: Must abide by specific dimensional rules, most notably returning to the fifth dimension if tricked into saying his name backward ('Kltpzyxm')
limitations: Bound by strict inter-dimensional rules and his self-imposed game conditions

sources.supports: Fifth-dimensional imp powers, reality warping, and the weakness of saying his name backward.

campaignTags.claim: Innate ability to hover and fly through space and dimensions
Instantly teleports across dimensions and locations at will
Can displace other individuals across space and reality

unknowns: True limits of his power if he ever fought with absolute seriousness without constraints

characters.summary: Mr. Freeze is a cryogenic scientist who wears a specialized life-support suit that grants him superhuman strength and projects absolute zero temperatures. He fights by encasing enemies in ice using cryogenic weaponry and freezing rays.
weaknesses: Physiological requirement for sub-zero temperatures to survive outside his suit
Vulnerability to intense heat which damages his life-support system
limitations: Cannot survive normal room temperatures without his refrigerated suit
Suit is vulnerable to heavy physical trauma and extreme heat

sources.supports: Cryo-suit, freeze gun, sub-zero condition, and heat vulnerability.

campaignTags.claim: Wears a heavy life-support armor suit that grants enhanced physical strength
Manipulates ambient temperature to freeze surroundings
Wields specialized freeze guns and cryogenic weaponry
Relies on advanced cryogenic engineering and technology
Master scientist who engineered his own freezing apparatus and survival suit

unknowns: Exact battery life or power source limits of the suit in protracted engagements

characters.summary: Nightwing (Dick Grayson) is a master acrobat and premier hand-to-hand combatant who relies on peak human conditioning, martial arts mastery, and specialized escrima sticks. He combines agile evasion with targeted strikes and tactical gadgets.

techniques: Escrima stick strikes and electrical discharges

weaknesses: Standard human vulnerability to bullets, blades, and overwhelming blunt force trauma
limitations: Subject to human physical fatigue and injury limits

sources.supports: Acrobatic skills, martial arts mastery, escrima sticks, and human physical limits.

campaignTags.claim: Uses utility belt containing batarang variants, explosives, and grappling lines
Escrima sticks can deliver high-voltage electrical shocks

unknowns: Exact durability limits of his specific tactical armor iterations

characters.summary: Ocean Master (Orm Marius) is an Atlantean powerhouse and master warrior who wields a powerful royal trident capable of controlling weather, generating magical energy blasts, and summoning marine life. He fights with disciplined royal combat techniques and vast oceanic control.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to extreme dehydration if kept away from water for extended periods in certain continuities
limitations: Trident loss significantly reduces his offensive energy projection and environmental control

sources.supports: Atlantean physiology, royal trident abilities, weather control, and combat skills.

campaignTags.claim: Natural Atlantean physiology adapted to deep ocean environments
Breathes underwater effortlessly
Exceptional swimming speed and maneuverability
Wields the royal trident which channels mystical and elemental forces
Controls oceanic currents and water through trident channeling

unknowns: Full extent of his physical strength compared directly to Aquaman without magical enhancements

characters.summary: The Penguin (Oswald Cobblepot) is a Gotham City crime lord who rarely engages in direct physical combat. He utilizes armed trick umbrellas, criminal syndicates, and subterranean hideouts to outmaneuver rivals.

techniques: Trick umbrellas equipped with firearms, blades, and gas projectiles

weaknesses: Subpar physical stamina, slow movement, and lack of genuine hand-to-hand combat proficiency
limitations: Physically unathletic and dependent on henchmen and gadgets

sources.supports: Crime lord status, trick umbrella usage, and reliance on henhenchmen.

campaignTags.claim: Carries specialized trick umbrellas with concealed weaponry

unknowns: Exact financial and criminal resource reserves during specific gang wars

characters.summary: Perpetua is a super-celestial Super-Creator of the Multiverse possessing absolute cosmic, reality-shaping, and crisis-level powers. She commands ultimate energy manipulation and entropy to unmake and recreate realities on a multi-versal scale.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to specialized Source Wall energies, Anti-Crisis energy, and combined cosmic opposition from prime entities
limitations: Requires vast amounts of harvested doom or crisis energy to maintain peak multiversal restructuring power

sources.supports: Status as a Super-Creator of the Multiverse, reality unmaking, and Crisis energy mastery.

notableResults.citation: Justice League (2018) issues regarding the Doom War
notableResults.note: Overwhelmed the combined roster until specialized anti-crisis forces intervened.

unknowns: Complete structural vulnerability to beings outside the jurisdiction of her specific multiversal sphere
